entities.summary: Alayna Jeanne Ertl was a 5-year-old girl from Watkins, Minnesota who was murdered after being kidnapped from her home on August 20, 2016. She was last seen alive at 2 a.m. Central Daylight Time and discovered missing 6 hours later. Following an investigation by local authorities and the Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension (BCA) she was found deceased at Wilderness Park in Cass County.
